_comment: Tier-2 for NGSolve heat#2, a catalog-drift correction: the prior claim that GridFunction storage grows 'only after gfu.Update()' was wrong. Measured on 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.5, H1(order=1): before Refine fes.ndof and len(gfu.vec) are both 8; after mesh.Refine() and WITHOUT any Update call, len(gfu.vec) already reads 21 -- and it is read FIRST so the ndof access is not what triggers it. FINDING: the claim's 'does not carry a prolongation of the old solution' is FALSE. Measured, the old DOF values are preserved entry-for-entry and the new DOFs are interpolated, not zero. The advice to re-solve is still right for a different reason -- the prolongated function is the coarse function re-expressed, so the representation error is bit-for-bit unchanged by the refine and only a re-Set improves it.
